clauses.clause: Garruk, Unleashed {2}{G}{G} Legendary Planeswalker — Garruk loyalty 4 (cast)
clauses.evidence: [cast]: hand -> stack -> battlefield, card gets 4 LOYALTY counter(s), mana C-2 G-2.

clauses.clause: [+1]: Up to one target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: [activate [0]] on each of the six creatures: loyalty 4 -> 5, P/T +3/+3 and keywords +TRAMPLE (you_bear 2/2 -> 5/5), both gone 'after the turn ends'; target slot 0..1, and [activate [0]] with no target pays the loyalty only. Packs J05_1, J05_2, J05_3.

clauses.clause: [−2]: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1]]: loyalty 4 -> 3 (-2, then +1), 'you:Beast moves new -> battlefield', 3/3; the engine's token object has colors ('G',) (inspected in J05_4's final state). Packs J05_4 to J05_7 count the tokens.

clauses.clause: Then if an opponent controls more creatures than you, put a loyalty counter on Garruk.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1]]: the opponent controls four creatures against my three (with the Beast): 'card gets 1 LOYALTY counter(s)'. The false branch and the 'Then' order are not in the trace: packs J05_4 (one against two before, two against two after the Beast: no counter), J05_5 (one against three: counter), J05_6 (three against two: none), J05_7 (only creatures count). Known limit, in BACKLOG 'Open engine faults': at three or more seats the comparison sums ALL opponents' creatures (the printed 'an opponent' is any one); the verified two-player play is exact.

clauses.clause: [−7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."
clauses.evidence: 'ability [2] not activatable from battlefield: cost:loyalty:4<7'. Packs J05_8 (the chosen creature card enters, the rest stays in the library), J05_9 (declined: nothing moves and the library is not shuffled), J05_10 (no trigger at the opponent's end step). Known limit, in BACKLOG B-107's residue: a library search can never fail to find (CR 701.19b), so after 'fire' a creature card present in the library must be taken; the 'may' still lets the player decline the whole search (J05_9).
